title: Label-free selection of exterior message strength
status_at_creation: frozen before new evaluation; no outcome pilot
selection: Each query observation vector individually selects gate with minimum mean Gaussian leave-one-observed-node-out negative log predictive density. No query truth, corruption labels or true covariance passed to selector. Ties select first (smallest) gate.
secondary: Marginal evidence score, held-out squared error and an independent 32-field unlabeled calibration batch. Exact Bayes and optimal-neighbor inference are oracle diagnostic controls, not available policies.
primary_criteria: LOO gate versus fixed full messages: sign accuracy gain lower 95% paired seed-t bound > 0 in flip50; intact lower bound > -0.005 (0.5 pp noninferiority). Both required. Report true NMSE independently, regardless of outcome.
statistics: Average over family and noise within each seed, then 10-seed paired Student-t intervals. Samples, configurations and policies are not independent seeds. Primary is an intersection-union criterion; secondary comparisons are exploratory.
separate_replication: Only after main results, a separately frozen secondary block may vary noise/family; no retuning main protocol.
cost: 6 candidate priors, 12 Cholesky factorizations (49/48 each) per graph/noise configuration, 6 dense observed precision matrices, per-observation LOO scores, selected 16-step inference. Report cache build, selection and selected-inference work separately; no free compute assumption or speed claim.
audit: LOO versus brute-force deletion, query edge invariance, coherent cycle balance, frozen-code SHA, selection independent of truth, same random inputs across corruption, no global RNG use.
scope: Known Gaussian family and supplied observation noise variances; no neural training, no LLM claim, no storage compression or general safety guarantee. Local frozen protocol, not external preregistration.
scoring: Primary Rao-Blackwellized conditional accuracy given observations using true query posterior only in evaluator; report sampled-truth accuracy too. Selection code has no true joint covariance/latent input.
